The famous Hindu navaratna (nine-pinnacled) temple dedicated to Goddess Kali, who is worshipped here as Ma Bhavatarini. The temple was inaugurated by Rani Rashmoni in 1855, and Ramakrishna Paramahamsa was the head and only priest of it…

A complex of trees consisting of banyan (বট boṭ), peepal (অশ্বত্থ oshwottho), neem (নিম nim), amla (আমলকী āmlokī) and woodapple (বেল bel) trees. This is where Ramakrishna performed his advaitic sādhonā in 1865.
The shrine dedicated to Rani Rashmoni, the founder of the temple.
A multi-span extradosed bridge, named after a disciple of Swami Vivekananda. See the Bally listing for details.
A long rail-cum-road bridge, commonly known as Bally Bridge (বালি ব্রিজ Bāli Brij). See the Bally listing for details.
Vegetarian meals such as chole bhature.
